## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* anonymous sectional-analysis (*kē* 科) navigational apparatus to the *Pǔxián guān jīng yìshū* ([KR6d0123](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0123), X35n0650) — Shénzhào [本如](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E5%A6%82) Běnrú's Sòng-period subcommentary on the *Pǔxián guān jīng* ([KR6d0120](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0120), T277).

**Abstract**

The *Yìshū kē* belongs together with the broader Sòng-Yuán-Míng tradition of providing structural-outline navigational apparatus for major commentarial works. Its preservation in the canonical apparatus alongside Běnrú's *Yìshū* ([KR6d0123](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0123)) demonstrates the editorial pattern of pairing major commentarial productions with their navigational-apparatus volumes.

The dating is bracketed within the Sòng-Yuán productive period for navigational apparatus on Běnrú's commentary (c. 1000–1300).
